listen.description: Explicit numeric IPv4/IPv6 SocketAddr. No default. Port zero permits an ephemeral listener. No plaintext mode.

tls_certificate_der.description: Absolute operator-owned DER X.509 certificate path outside repository.

tls_private_key_der.description: Absolute private PKCS#8 DER key path; owner-only file. Key/certificate must match.

client_credential_file.description: Absolute private regular file outside repository. 32..256 ASCII non-whitespace bytes; one optional trailing LF. Secret<String> in memory; no Debug/Display.

store.description: Absolute version-1 task JSON path in owner-only directory. Canonicalize parent; refuse symlinks. Hold companion .lock OS lease until exit.

report_socket.description: Absolute Unix socket path in owner-only (0700) directory; socket 0600. Explicit path only.

gadget_program.description: Absolute operator-configured executable. Only fixed send-user-msg argv; never selected from a request.

oneOf.description: Explicit T3 seam; allowed only with --control-stdin and listen IP exactly 127.0.0.1. Never accepted for LAN binding. No HTTP or callback clock control.
